items.title: Marvell (MRVL) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift As AI Data Center Optimism Builds
items.summary: Marvell Technology is back in focus after an analyst fair value estimate was revised from US$118.93 to US$254.41, a sharp reset in how some models frame the stock’s long term potential. Much of that shift lines up with recent Street commentary that leans on AI data center exposure, optical interconnect strength, and custom silicon programs, while still flagging premium valuation and customer concentration as key watchpoints. Read on to see what is driving this evolving narrative around...
